findings.title: After a business-unit-scoped Lead creates a transformation, its detail page hides the Edit/Archive controls and the audit trail until a full page reload (stale cached /api/v1/me grants)
findings.reproduction: Disposable clone of candidate f0baa87d0163560f (4f486b96), `pnpm -r build`, then `QA_E2E_PG_PORT=5473 e2e/support/qa-stack.sh npx playwright test e2e/qa-r3 --workers=1` with docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r3-derived-audit-localized.spec.ts. Sign in as dev.lead (TL at SYN-RETAIL only), create a record in SYN-RETAIL, land on /transformations/<id>. Measured in EN and AR: immediately after create, audit-trail regions = 0 and Edit links = 0. After in-app (client-side) navigation to the list and back, still 0 and 0. After page.reload(), 1 and 1. A second probe (dg1-r3-stale-session-probe.spec.ts, 19-stale-session-probe.log) waits 61 s and dispatches visibilitychange+focus: still 0 and 0, and /api/v1/me is never re-fetched after the create. Cause (code reading): apps/web/src/api/queries.ts:49 caches `me` with staleTime 60 s. TransformationCreatePage.tsx:119 invalidates only ['transformations'], not keys.me, so the derived transformation-scope grant that the server adds on create (F-DG1-106) is absent from the client's grants, and `canOn(me, ...)` is false for the new record. The FE4 handback §4 reports the same observation. It is not registered in findings.json, and the journey spec works around it with page.reload().
findings.expected: A BU-scoped Lead who has just created a record sees the controls their (server-granted) access allows on it (Edit, Archive, audit trail) without a manual browser reload. For example, invalidate or refetch the `me` query after a successful create (or derive the grant from the 201 response). F-DG1-004 and F-DG1-106 opened this path, and the server already authorizes it.
findings.actual: The post-create page shows the record without Edit/Archive and without its audit trail. In-app navigation doesn't fix it, and neither did a 61 s wait with a focus signal. Only a full reload or a new sign-in restores it. No hint is shown. It is fail-safe: the UI under-represents access, nothing is leaked or over-granted, the server stays authoritative and there's no data impact. It degrades the BU lead's create -> edit/archive workflow, so it is not optional polish. A real user's tab switch may refetch differently from the synthetic focus signal; that was not tested.

history.note: Reported in DG1 round-3 QA verification. Reproduced in EN and AR (2/2), plus a 61 s focus probe. Independent of the FE4 handback observation, which it confirms.
